subject: Hosted API pricing - monthly tokens & peak TPS
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing - follow up & quick clarifications

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for the time today — great call. To make sure we build an accurate pricing and capacity proposal, two quick clarifications from our side:

1) Expected steady-state monthly token volume (approx):
   - What range should we plan for in months 1–3 vs months 6–12? (ballpark is fine)
2) Peak latency-sensitive traffic (peak TPS and average tokens per request):
   - Any expected spikes (e.g., batch job vs interactive chat) and the peak TPS we should design for?
3) Budget expectations and target unit economics:
   - Do you have a target cost (e.g., $/1M tokens) or monthly budget range for hosted API usage?

I'll attach our standard pricing sheet for reference. If you prefer, we can convert this into a mutual action plan after you share the numbers.

Next steps: if you can reply with the three items above, I will run projected monthly costs and share 2 pricing scenarios (conservative / aggressive) and a recommended peak TPS sizing.

Thanks — talk soon.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: pricing-sheet-2026Q4.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Elaine Park <elaine@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing - follow up & quick clarifications

Hi Ben —

Great talking — answers below:

1) Monthly token volume:
   - Months 1–3 (pilot): ~50M tokens/month
   - Months 4–6: ~200M tokens/month
   - Months 7–12: 500M–1B tokens/month depending on adoption
2) Peak TPS & request size:
   - Interactive chat peak: ~45 TPS sustained over 2–3 minute bursts
   - Average tokens/request: 600 tokens (prompt+response)
   - We also have nightly batch enrichment jobs that hit high throughput but can be queued (up to ~150 TPS for short windows)
3) Budget & unit economics:
   - Preliminary budget: $10k–$30k/month during pilot; $50k–$150k/month scale
   - Ideally target <$25 per 1M tokens if possible; open to tradeoffs on latency/features

We have a procurement squad (procurement@fintechco.com) that will need an MSA and SOW; happy to share any additional usage stats if helpful.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Head of Product
FintechCo

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@fintechco.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 13:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing - follow up & quick clarifications

Thanks for the detail — super helpful.

Based on the ranges you provided, here are two quick options we can model (hosted API):

A) Pilot / conservative
   - 50M tokens/month
   - Peak 45 TPS handling interactive; allow burst headroom to 100 TPS
   - Price target: $35 / 1M tokens (includes streaming + support)
   - Estimated monthly cost (tokens only): ~$1,750

B) Scale / negotiated commit
   - 500M tokens/month (mid of your scale range)
   - Reserved capacity sizing for sustained peaks (we'd size for 150 TPS bursts)
   - Price target we can pursue: $18–22 / 1M tokens with a quarterly commit and simple SLA
   - Estimated monthly cost (tokens only at $20/1M): ~$10,000

Notes:
- We can offer a custom commit/discount negotiation if you can lock a 3–6 month minimum for the scale tier; that would let us get closer to your <$25 / 1M tokens target.
- Attachment: SOW-draft.pdf (high-level delivery timeline & success metrics) — I'll share a cleaned DocuSign link after you confirm.

Next steps: If this looks reasonable, Marissa (cc) will draft a short mutual action plan and procurement-friendly SOW. If procurement prefers, we can also provide a line-item MSA and security pack (SOC 2 artifacts).

Would you like us to price a middle-ground 200M tokens/month scenario as well? That looks like a realistic ramp for months 4–6.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOW-draft.pdf (application/pdf)

Appreciate the clear options. The 200M/month middle-ground would be perfect for our internal approval process. Can you send the priced scenario for 200M tokens and a short MAP + estimated timeline? Procurement will also review the SOW draft this afternoon.

If you can get the 200M estimate + MAP by end of day Friday PST, we'll review and aim to have a procurement decision next week.

Thanks,
Elaine
